sdlc-setup-wiki.short_description: Create, upgrade or link a project wiki
sdlc-setup-wiki.default_prompt: Use $sdlc-setup-wiki to set up, upgrade or link the project wiki for this folder.

sdlc-write-spec.short_description: Turn intent into approved wiki requirements
sdlc-write-spec.default_prompt: Use $sdlc-write-spec to write and approve a Feature or ChangeRequest specification.

sdlc-write-stories.short_description: Break approved requirements into user stories
sdlc-write-stories.default_prompt: Use $sdlc-write-stories to write the user stories of a ReqApproved or Approved Feature or ChangeRequest.

sdlc-design-arch.short_description: Design target architecture from approved requirements
sdlc-design-arch.default_prompt: Use $sdlc-design-arch to design the target architecture of a ReqApproved Feature or ChangeRequest.

sdlc-plan-tasks.short_description: Break an approved design into build tasks
sdlc-plan-tasks.default_prompt: Use $sdlc-plan-tasks to plan the build Tasks of an Approved Feature or ChangeRequest.

sdlc-design-tests.short_description: Design traceable test suites and cases
sdlc-design-tests.default_prompt: Use $sdlc-design-tests to design TestSuites and TestCases for an Approved Feature or ChangeRequest.

sdlc-ask-wiki.short_description: Answer questions from the project wiki
sdlc-ask-wiki.default_prompt: Use $sdlc-ask-wiki to list features, show an architecture or answer a question from the project wiki.

sdlc-import.short_description: Bring existing code, documents and tests into the wiki
sdlc-import.default_prompt: Use $sdlc-import to import this existing code, document or test suite into the project wiki, or to compare it with what the wiki already says.

sdlc-review-code.short_description: Review a code change against the project wiki
sdlc-review-code.default_prompt: Use $sdlc-review-code to review this code change against the project wiki.

sdlc-build-task.short_description: Write the code of one wiki Task
sdlc-build-task.default_prompt: Use $sdlc-build-task to write the code and unit tests of this wiki Task in this code repository.

sdlc-close-task.short_description: Record in the wiki that a Task's code is merged
sdlc-close-task.default_prompt: Use $sdlc-close-task to record in the project wiki that this Task's code is merged.

sdlc-edit-wiki.short_description: Make a small edit no lifecycle skill owns
sdlc-edit-wiki.default_prompt: Use $sdlc-edit-wiki to fix wording, the glossary or conventions, mark a Feature released, or link a Task's ticket.

sdlc-convert-doc.short_description: Route documents through MarkItDown or Marker
sdlc-convert-doc.default_prompt: Use $sdlc-convert-doc to convert this local document into clean Markdown.
